templates.label: Professional
templates.hint: Clean lines on a dark box, in your brand's caption type.

templates.label: Social
templates.hint: A few bold words at a time, the spoken word in your accent colour.

templates.label: Minimal
templates.hint: Quiet white lines with a soft shadow and nothing behind them.

templates.label: Moody
templates.hint: Small, light, lower-case and widely spaced, in a warm tone.

templates.label: Layered
templates.hint: Huge words behind the speaker's head. Best when the speaker isn't too close: in a close-up the head hides most of the words.
